custody_model: Reviewed first-party launch and product notices establish a fixed-term yield product but do not provide sufficient dedicated authority to characterize EARN balances as segregated, insured, trust-protected or otherwise insulated from BitMEX counterparty exposure. Historical insurance-fund backing language is preserved only as an operator claim.
yield_source: BitMEX published fixed-term EARN products with contractual interest. Published APRs are issuer product terms and are not independently verified realized returns or evidence of underlying economic performance.
risk_notes: Current operational status is unresolved. Contractual principal-plus-interest at maturity does not establish universal historical repayment performance, and ordinary exchange custody protections are not generalized to EARN balances.
